canonical_title: Maximum intensities in over-lapping beams of forward and rear position lights

versions.title_at_revision: Maximum intensities in over-lapping beams of forward and rear position lights
versions.text: No position light intensity may exceed the applicable values in the following table, except as provided in CS 25.1389 (b)(3): Maximum intensity Overlaps Area A Area B candela candela (candles) (candles) Green in dihedral angle L 10 1 Red in dihedral angle R 10 1 Green in dihedral angle A 5 1 Red in dihedral angle A 5 1 Rear white in dihedral 5 1 angle L Rear white in dihedral 5 1 angle R Where – (a) Area A includes all directions in the adjacent dihedral angle that pass through the light source and intersect the common boundary plane at more than 10º but less than 20º; and (b) Area B includes all directions in the adjacent dihedral angle that pass through the light source and intersect the common boundary plane at more than 20º.
